messages:
jen-docs: FYI I opened a docs PR for the HSM vendor migration guide + a small Go SDK example for hitting a private control plane in air-gapped installs. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra-docs/pull/12910

jen-docs: scope: migration checklist when customers switch HSM vendors, where to stage cert bundles, nftables examples (we're recommending nftables on newer distros), and a tiny Go snippet showing how to override the control plane URL.

ryan-sre: thanks. can we call out SELinux/AppArmor steps? we saw a support case where the HSM daemon couldn't read /var/run/hsm because of context issues.

jen-docs: added a short section: `restorecon -R /var/run/hsm` and systemd unit: `ProtectHome=no` + `PrivateTmp=false` with a note explaining tradeoffs. left a TODO to capture exact audit log examples.

aya-sec: one security flag: make sure to instruct customers to validate HSM vendor firmware checksums and to notarize PKCS#11 library paths. also mention abstract unix sockets vs filesystem sockets.

jen-docs: included vendor checksum check paragraph and a snippet to run `sha256sum` on the firmware bundle. added note about abstract sockets and how to detect them (`ss -xlp` shows `@` prefix on Linux).

ryan-sre: for firewall rules please prefer nftables example (Ubuntu 22.04 / RHEL9 users). many of our docs still show iptables only. small example: ```
# allow kms-relay port
add rule inet filter input tcp dport 1793 accept
# permit control-plane egress to repo/proxy (example)
add rule inet filter output ip daddr 203.0.113.0/24 accept
```

jen-docs: replaced iptables with nftables examples, and left an inline note for older distros with iptables-legacy.

cloud-rel: add a short paragraph on routing when using VPC peering + transit gateway. customers get tripped up about which ENI does egress. a tiny ascii flow helps.

jen-docs: added an ASCII flow for clarity: ```
[onprem HSM host] --(peer)-> [customer mgmt VPC] --(transit GW)-> [egress VPC / NAT / proxy]
(note: control plane egress originates from the NAT subnet attached to the egress VPC)
```

linkbot: link-check: /installer/legacy-checksums.md -> 404. Suggested replacement: /install/checksums.yml

jen-docs: thanks - fixed link and added a redirect note for old URLs. also updated the release checklist to remind releases to publish checksums to the checksums.yml path.

aya-sec: we should include an explicit mTLS curl example for kms-relay auth. snippet please.

jen-docs: added under KMS auth examples:
```
# mTLS curl to kms-relay
curl --cert /etc/redwood/certs/client.crt --key /etc/redwood/certs/client.key \ 
  --cacert /etc/redwood/certs/ca.crt https://127.0.0.1:1793/v1/unseal
```

jen-docs: also added a Go SDK example (single-file) showing ControlPlaneURL override for air-gapped deploys:
```
package main
import (
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "bytes"
)
func main() {
  url := "https://10.0.5.12/api/v1/generate" // private control plane
  payload := []byte(`{"model":"redwood-small","input":"hello"}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", url, bytes.NewBuffer(payload))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer $TOKEN")
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  client := &http.Client{}
  resp, err := client.Do(req)
  if err != nil { panic(err) }
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  fmt.Println("status:", resp.Status)
}
```

ryan-sre: small nit  replace $TOKEN with a placeholder string in the Go snippet to avoid shell var confusion. also mention `-k` for self-signed cert testing in examples but mark as DO NOT USE in production.

jen-docs: updated Go snippet to use "REPLACE_WITH_TOKEN" and added `// for testing only: InsecureSkipVerify` note and a link to cert rotation docs.

cloud-rel: last ask: add a short rollback and verification section for the HSM migration. steps to revert vendor lib, restart agent, and check `systemctl status redwood-agent`.

jen-docs: added rollback bullets: snapshot old libs, switch symlink at /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so -> vendor, restart agent, run `journalctl -u redwood-agent -f` to verify. also included quick grep examples to check for PKCS11 errors.

linkbot: deploy-check: docs lint OK, 1 link warning (external vendor checksum URL flagged, added reviewer note).

jen-docs: thanks everyone, tagging reviewers @ryan-sre @aya-sec @cloud-rel. will merge after two approvals.
